name: settings popover OPEN (reveals label.language, which is display:none until the gear is pressed)
preset dropdown OPEN (reveals label.presets / label.noPresets — both are created by buildDropdownMenu() at runtime and do not exist in the markup at all until the name field is clicked)
auto-gain ARMED (reveals label.autoGainOn — #auto-gain-toggle renders label.autoGainOff at rest, so the ON face is never measured in the default state)
